No X close icon or additional back-to-directory control invented. Clean editable source state, no unsaved close guard shown. Second row left 白板 kind and app-owned HTML code / 打印 printer / PNG image export icons; right actual tabs 白板 active, Markdown 源码, 阅读, PNG 预览.
Canvas fills every remaining pixel across full viewport width. Exact blank white zero-element Excalidraw scene, no shapes. Existing native closed hamburger upper-left, centered source toolbar lock/hand/selection(active)/rectangle/diamond/ellipse/arrow/line/freehand/text/image/eraser/extra tools, closed 素材库 trigger upper-right, faint pan-help below. Bottom-left zoom minus/100%/plus and disabled undo/redo, bottom-right help ?.
